caption: In re Application of RH2 Participações Societárias Ltda.
citation_line: In re Application of RH2 Participações Societárias Ltda., No. 3:23-cv-04025, ECF No. 19 (D.N.J. July 31, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied motions to quash subpoenas for use in Brazilian litigation under § 1782. Applying Intel, the court differentiated party and nonparty respondents, rejected circumvention based only on more restrictive Brazilian procedures, and required narrowing and confidentiality negotiations.
qualification_rationale: A substantial international-judicial-assistance opinion on comity, foreign proof gathering, extraterritorial document access, and tailoring overbroad discovery.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery order; no substantive appellate review identified.
